parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: NodeGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the node group.

parameters.name: NodeIds
parameters.description: Limits the check scope. If not specified, all nodes in the node group are checked. <warning>If the model is a super node, pass the TrayNode ID.</warning>
